name: Petty Squabbles
summary: You are asked to speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the edge of the Blasted Lands and the swamp. The meeting is the whole of what is asked here.

sections.title: At the Border
sections.body: At the border of the Blasted Lands and the swamp, you are asked to find the Fallen Hero of the Horde. Speak with him there; nothing more is asked of you here.

faq.q: Who do I need to speak with?
faq.answer: You are asked to speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

faq.q: Where can I find the Fallen Hero?
faq.answer: He is at the border of the Blasted Lands and the swamp.

faq.q: What am I asked to do?
faq.answer: You are asked to speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the border of the Blasted Lands and the swamp.
